meta.note: Three-tile model. bodyPlan + signpostPlan per type. Single-direction types split their key pool into keyOpen (works as the FIRST body move) and keyMore (continuation phrases that imply a prior point), so line 1 always reads like an opening. for-against keeps its genuine for/for/against turn. · Oct 2026: bank phrases from data1/ vetted and promoted into the pools (converted to slot form); keys that repeated a signpost or an opinion verb, and so broke the signpost + view + key roll, were removed. · 22 Nov 2026 (audit): no Therefore/Hence/Consequently before an aim and no questions as an aim; a thesis promises only what the body gives (Problems: solutions; Trends: how it may develop); Your view states the pupil's view either way and closes on it; Cause & Effect's third paragraph is an effect (keyEffect). The open.hinge lists stay for slide-galleries-fetching.html; Build no longer glues them between two gaps.
